user_goal.text: Determine how many unread email threads are in the user's Gmail outbox.

benchmark_success.rationale: TestTracker success requires every registered test to pass.

checked_by.text: Official AppWorld evaluate() registered TestTracker checks compare the submitted answer under test.answer(...) and require changed_model_names() to equal the empty set.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end model-state diff and official TestTracker result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained model diff show an empty changed-model-name set and that the registered no-model-changes test passed?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The first registered block applies the evaluator's explicit answer-comparison rule.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_818d3311397a] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert no model changes.
success_if.rationale: The second registered block requires the changed-model-name set to be empty.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: Failure of the evaluator's registered answer-comparison block counts as native failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_818d3311397a] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert no model changes.
fail_if.rationale: A nonempty changed-model-name set fails the registered no-model-changes block.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
